name: Sasaki Haruka
source:
She has been a fan since Renta started his streaming channel, and later joins Team Revo as a staff member.

A gentle, mild-mannered woman who seems like kindness personified. The big-sister type.
She has a soft-spoken manner and is truly soothing to be around.
She is especially kind to older people and younger boys. 
She is not the type to strike up conversations very often. She has only a little knowledge of subculture.
She’s a huge Renta fan and boasts, “There’s no fan who knows more about Renta than I do.”
In fact, her friends have to listen to her talk about him so often that they’re starting to get a little neurotic.

With her enormous J-cup bust and soothing personality, she was constantly being confessed to by the men around her, but—
—she’s hopeless when it comes to romance. “You’ll find someone much better than me~” she’d say, artfully dodging every advance. As a result, she’s a natural-born innocent with zero experience with men.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/1210593/]Getchu[/url]]
